subject: The map at SceneDatabase+18h: its key type and comparison, its node layout, the 5Ch record it holds, the scene-reader branch that fills it, and the four native routines that read it.
conclusion: SceneDatabase+18h is std::map<NativeString, SceneHiddenEntityRecord*, LessCaseInsensitive>, the scene database's index of entities the scene file authored with the Hidden property set. Those entities are parsed but not instantiated; the record keeps everything needed to instantiate one later by name. The Lua binding name FindHiddenEntity is recovered, not a hypothesis: the string at 00D0FE10 is paired with 008A9E10 in the binding table at 00E0BFF0.

corrections.target: docs/SCENE_ENTITY_CREATE.md, the record table under "The record in the map at SceneDatabase+18h" (owned by another packet; not edited)
corrections.was: +8h / +0Ch is one NativeString className, length at +8h (marked provisional, not read there).
corrections.is: +8h and +0Ch are two independent owned char* fields. +8h is the entity name, +0Ch the class name; there is no length field for either.
corrections.evidence: 004693C0 writes [record+8] = 00438E40(a3) at 00469411 and [record+0Ch] = 00438E40(a2) at 00469428, from two different constructor arguments. 00438E40 BSP_NativeString_Duplicate is strdup in ECX. The destructor 00469300 frees both separately with the CRT free at 00469344 and 00469357, which a NativeString buffer would never be (those go back to the sized storage pool).

corrections.target: docs/SCENE_ENTITY_CREATE.md, same table, the +14h..+53h row's field name (not edited)
corrections.is: The frame the reader hands 0046C550 as a4 at 0046D62D, which is the entity's own frame with the parent's world frame travelling separately as the by-value argument. Naming it local is right; the note worth adding is that both creators pass identity for the parent frame, so a nested hidden entity would be instantiated at its parent-relative pose.
corrections.evidence: 0046D62D LEA EDX,[ESP+94h] with ESP = entry-1F8h resolves to entry-164h, the same address 004693C0 receives as a5 at 0046D6D2 (LEA EDX,[ESP+4Ch] with ESP = entry-1B0h). The composition calls 00413920 at 0046D852 and 0046D875 build the child's argument, not this one.

corrections.target: docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md, the Hidden row of the property table (owned by another packet; not edited)
corrections.was: when set (and this+4h non-zero) the normal instantiation is skipped and the hidden branch runs instead
corrections.is: the second operand is argument a6 at entry+54h, not this+4h; and there is a fourth gate, the registration argument at entry+58h, which must be zero
corrections.evidence: 0046D5FA reads [ESP+200h] and 0046D679 reads [ESP+204h]; the prologue PUSH -1 / PUSH handler / PUSH EAX / SUB ESP,190h / PUSH EBX / PUSH EBP / PUSH ESI / PUSH EDI puts ESP at entry-1ACh, so those are entry+54h and entry+58h. RET 58h makes entry+58h the last argument. The same anchor gives arg1 at 0046CF5D.

corrections.was: class_key, described as keying the record map
corrections.is: it is the authored entity name; the map is keyed by entity name, not by class
corrections.evidence: The key and record+8h come from the same buffer (see record_layout.key_identity), and record+0Ch (the class name) is what the class map at +34h is keyed by. docs/LUA_BINDING_GENERATE_OBJECT.md line 67 already calls argument 0 the authored object's name.

uncertainties: The indirect call at 0046D66B (EAX = *(local+8), the local at entry-188h, ECX = the property bag, result discarded) sits between the generation gate and the Party read and was not identified.

Whether nested hidden entities are recorded: the recursive call at 0046D8A9 passes a local at entry-188h as a6 rather than the caller's a6, so gate 2 for a child is not established. The shipped .scn files were not scanned for a nested Hidden entity.
record+10h (party) has no reader among the routines in this packet.
No run-time evidence: nothing here was confirmed against a run log of bsp_game.exe.

follow_up_packets.question: Who reads record+10h. The party value is written by the reader and never read by either creator.
The a6 local at entry-188h of the recursion, and whether nested Hidden entities reach the map.

reconstruction.shape: the record as a documented struct with offset constants, the key comparison and the map lookup as pure rules over an injected view, and the inserter and the two wrappers as sequences over an injected host with one virtual method per native call site
not_ported: the CRT string and pool helpers
reconstruction.status: reconstructed, build-tested; not ABI-compatible and not game-validated
